#include <mdsp_core/Version.h>

#pragma once

#include <juce_graphics/juce_graphics.h>
#include <mdsp_ui/Theme.h>

namespace mdsp_ui
{

/**
 * @brief Marker rendering utilities (centerlines, crosshairs, cursor lines, dots)
 * 
 * Theme-based marker primitives for consistent UI rendering.
 * No allocations in render calls.
 */
class MarkerRenderer
{
public:
    /**
     * @brief Draw a centerline (horizontal or vertical) through plot bounds
     * @param g Graphics context
     * @param plotBounds Rectangle bounds of the plot area
     * @param horizontal If true, draw horizontal centerline; if false, vertical
     * @param theme Theme for colors
     * @param alpha Alpha value (0.0-1.0)
     * @param thickness Line thickness
     * @param clipToPlot If true, clip line to plot bounds
     */
    static void drawCenterLine (juce::Graphics& g,
                                const juce::Rectangle<int>& plotBounds,
                                bool horizontal,
                                const Theme& theme,
                                float alpha = 0.4f,
                                float thickness = 1.0f,
                                bool clipToPlot = true) noexcept;

    /**
     * @brief Draw a crosshair centered at (centerX, centerY)
     * @param g Graphics context
     * @param centerX X coordinate of center
     * @param centerY Y coordinate of center
     * @param radiusX Horizontal radius (half-width)
     * @param radiusY Vertical radius (half-height)
     * @param theme Theme for colors
     * @param alpha Alpha value (0.0-1.0)
     * @param thickness Line thickness
     */
    static void drawCrosshair (juce::Graphics& g,
                               float centerX,
                               float centerY,
                               float radiusX,
                               float radiusY,
                               const Theme& theme,
                               float alpha = 0.4f,
                               float thickness = 1.0f) noexcept;
